profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with over 20 years of experience building high-performance, low-latency systems at scale. At Google, I led infrastructure projects supporting mission-critical C++ RPC frameworks used across thousands of services, with a focus on performance tuning, resource optimization, and real-time reliability—earning two Perfy awards for cutting CPU costs through core system redesigns.

My background spans distributed systems, real-time pipelines, and systems-level architecture. I’ve designed coroutine-based APIs for ultra-fast request handling, built benchmarks and profiling tools to monitor performance regressions, and optimized concurrency models to maximize throughput. Earlier in my career, I scaled a custom IOCP-based ad server to over 5,000 QPS per server—experience directly relevant to latency-sensitive environments like financial trading.

Fluent in C++, C#, Go, Java, and SQL, I bring deep expertise in system architecture, scalability, and automated testing. I thrive in high-stakes environments where nanoseconds matter and infrastructure stability is paramount.

I’m now looking to bring this skill set to a fast-paced, technically rigorous environment like automated trading. If your firm is seeking someone who can deliver measurable performance gains and engineering excellence under pressure, let’s connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Boq Scaffolding Team
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Supporting a server framework used in the majority of C++ based RPC services across thousands of teams at Google, with various modules for performing common server tasks, automated deployment and automated conformance testing to ensure users are following best practices.  
Collaborated on the design & implementation of new C++20 coroutine based APIs.
Refactored the object conformance test, which does static analysis of Boq Scaffolding server code to check for the use of disallowed APIs, for better scalability & performance, saving roughly 4 SWEs (18,000 forge CPUs) in build overhead.  Added the ability to distinguish between code called from coroutine hooks vs other places in the code to have a larger set of banned APIs for coroutine code which should not make blocking calls and has different cancellation semantics.
Put together load tests & microbenchmarks for various usage scenarios, for automated detection of performance regressions, along with a GWP (Google Wide Profiling) classifier to measure framework overhead in production.
Mentored 5 more junior team members

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Geo Tiger Team)
positions.description:
Maintained various pipelines for improving the quality of business titles and categories on Google Maps.    Various signals used in machine learning models to determine when business titles and categories are most likely incorrect and create edits for them.
Improved the quality of titles and categories selected by Sprout pipelines for new businesses, using libraries and models created for Tiger.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Geo Sprout Team
positions.description: Maintained various pipelines for identifying new businesses from data in the search index and adding them to Google Maps.

positions.title: Software Engineer - DoubleClick Ads Serving
positions.description:
Various integration projects between legacy DoubleClick Ad Servers and Google services.
Created a new custom reporting system for advertisers, and many other smaller services built and maintained by our team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Software Engineer on the Ad Serving team, maintaining the custom IOCP based C++ service that did ad selection and serving for ~300,000 QPS of ads on ~200 servers.   Also maintained 13 other related services.
Refactored how I/O to backends works from the server, along with the request threading model to be able to handle 5,000+ QPS per server with fewer worker threads.  This turned out to be more critical with the various google integration projects.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · PL/SQL · PostgreSQL · Concurrent Programming · C++.net

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Developed new custom workflows & reports in the Equitrak portfolio management application for various customers, in VB6 & VB.NET supporting both MSSQL & Sybase SQL backends.

https://www.vitechinc.com/
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · VB · VBScript · PL/SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Wrote COM components and SQL stored procedures used to validate and manipulate account, address, and credit card information on the site, and for storing and searching seller account information, and XSLT transforms for sending seller information between systems. (VB6, Microsoft T-SQL, Oracle PL-SQL, XSLT)
Performed code reviews to track down various site issues (C++, ASP, VB6)
Developed a web crawler to search for broken links within sections of the barnesandnoble.com site. (C#)
Created and used LoadRunner test scripts for testing site performance, testing against front-end web servers, search engines, SQL servers, & other tiers of the barnesandnoble.com site, and performed analysis of load test results
Created automated test scripts for doing functional testing of the web site, both through the front end web interface and with tests which called the underlying COM components directly, with the output of the functional tests used for regression testing as well. (C#, VB6, VBScript, Perl)
Created a COM DLL for collecting a large number of performance counters from production servers for displaying on a site monitoring application. (C++)
Wrote scripts for collecting statistical data from web logs for business analysts. (AWK)
Wrote scripts for collecting statistics on site errors based on logs. (AWK)

http://www.bn.com/
positions.insights: Skills: VB6 · ASP · LoadRunner · C (Programming Language) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · COM · C# · Awk · PL/SQL

positions.title: Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: One of 3 developers at the GameInstitute, an e-learning startup providing courses on video game development.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · COM+ · Active Server Pages (ASP) · ActiveX Data Objects (ADO) · HTML

positions.title: Director of Search Technology
positions.description:
Designed & built the search engine that found who is in your nth degree and the shortest path between any two people on the site for SixDegrees, a social media site where content could be filtered to that from people in your 2nd or 3rd degree.  (C++).  Made this more scalable by sharding the in-memory data for it across multiple machines.

Wrote a new e-mail sending system for site notifications (Java), as sending emails using out of the box SMTP servers like q-mail, sendmail, & Microsoft IIS was not scaling.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote & improved applications for measuring crystal oscillator frequencies using fourier analysis, and producing graphs of their response.

Translated Borland Delphi application to Borland C++ Builder.
https://mtron.com/
positions.insights: Skills: Borland Delphi · Borland C++ Builder · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Technical Adminstrative Assistant
positions.description:
Support at Central Florida's 2nd largest ISP at the time.  http://ao.net/
Put together software installer packages for Mac users including dial-up software, Netscape, Eudora, FTP & Usenet clients, etc.
Updated and configured all modems,
Varied technical support.
Developed custom web sites with C-based CGI scripts for several client web sites doing dynamic queries of data they uploaded to us.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · HTML · Modems · Technical Support

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained & improved several different laser-control systems, primarily in Microsoft C.

The primary 2 applications were a laser bellows welder, where it tracked the seam being welded while a bellows is rotated to keep the laser aimed at it in real-time, and an application for reading AutoCAD drawings and controlling rotating mirrors a motion table to engrave the drawings into anodized metal plates with the laser.

As a test of the mirror & laser controls, I created an application which could engrave any grayscale image into the metal, like a hologram, which Laser Applications sold to Honda.

Set up the company website.
